name: What factors should I consider when choosing a company for cabinet repair or refinishing?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a company for cabinet repair or refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a company, consider their experience with cabinet repair and refinishing, their portfolio of past projects, and customer reviews. Ensure they are licensed and insured. Inquire about the types of materials and finishes they use, and if they offer detailed, transparent estimates. A reputable company will also provide clear communication and a warranty for their work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider experience, portfolio, reviews, licensing, insurance, materials used, clear estimates, and warranties when choosing a company.
